verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published per-task or per-browser-hour prices and no documented rate or concurrency limits. The only pricing-related material is a relative marketing claim ("7x more affordable than browser-use") and a community complaint about cost, neither of which gives transparent pricing or limits a developer could check before committing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see transparent per-task or per-browser-hour pricing and documented rate/concurrency limits before committing
